articles.title: ADHD and autism at risk of over-diagnosis, says government review
articles.description: The review, which focuses on younger age groups, warned there was a risk society was moving from an era of under-diagnosis to over-diagnosis or mis-diagnosis.

articles.title: Burnham calls on Polanski to reverse Green Party's Zionism motion
articles.description: The prime minister has intervened in the row over the motion passed by members at Green Party conference.

articles.title: Warrants used to search Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's homes were unlawful, court says
articles.description: A criminal investigation into the former prince continues and police have retained material seized from his homes.

articles.title: Suspect linked to Monaco bomb attack on millionaire breaks silence to BBC
articles.description: Vitalii Zhykovych gives his own account of the attempted assassination of Ukrainian-born businessman Vadym Yermolayev.
